customManagers.description: immich's chart-wide image tag has no sibling repository key - server and machine-learning each supply their own and inherit the tag - so the helm-values manager has no depName and cannot track it
claudebox installs Claude Code and the Codex CLI with npm in an init container, pinned as env values that no built-in manager reads

packageRules.description: Pinned at v1.14.0: newer 1.14.x releases send empty x-amz-tagging to B2
kubectl supports one minor of skew from the API server. The node runs k3s 1.33, so hold this at 1.33.x and move the range by hand when k3s moves.

Databases and indexes that migrate their on-disk format on a version bump, and cannot be rolled back afterwards. Meilisearch v1.53.2 was automerged on 2026-09-13 and crashlooped karakeep's index until it was pinned back. A MariaDB series bump needs mariadb-upgrade, and a PostGIS bump needs ALTER EXTENSION. Renovate proposes these; a human runs them.

Every Nextcloud bump migrates the database and the app-store apps, and the pod reports Ready while it is half done: status.php answers 200 with needsDbUpgrade true. Patch 35.0.1 was automerged on 2026-09-25 and returned 503 to every client for 19 hours. Renovate proposes these; a human merges them and checks status.php afterwards.

Both CLIs ship several releases a day. Grouped so a bump restarts claudebox, and the sessions running in it, at most once a night. The two-day age skips releases that upstream pulls or hotfixes, and keeps a freshly published npm package from reaching a pod that holds cluster and GitHub credentials the same day.
